recipe.visualDefinition: A layered patriotic composition featuring a sharp, high-contrast waving American flag in the foreground set against a desaturated, soft-focus background of the same flag motif. The layout uses a top-heavy headline in a dark blue script and a bottom-right corner for branding and contact information.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground flag creates a diagonal movement from bottom-left to center-right.
Background flag provides a muted texture that echoes the foreground subject.
Dark blue typography contrasts against the lighter, desaturated background areas.
Small red graphic element at the bottom anchors the branding section.
coreInvariants: Waving flag texture with visible fabric folds
Dual-layer flag motif (one sharp, one blurred)
Dark navy blue primary text color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A primary waving flag occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, angled diagonally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark blue script headline at the top center-left acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top headline, follow the curve of the flag downward to the right, ending at the branding in the bottom-right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant is kept relatively clear of foreground elements to allow the headline to breathe.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and muted red/blue in the background flag.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue used for all primary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red used for the small icon in the bottom corner.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground flag; low saturation/high value in the background flag to create depth.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Casual, upright script for the headline; sturdy serif for the branding.
letterConstructionRules: Headline features connected lowercase letters with high stroke contrast.
Uppercase letters in the headline are decorative but legible.
Body text uses a traditional, high-readability serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'C' in the headline has a deep, sweeping curve.
The 'A' is stylized with a crossbar that extends slightly.

composition.relationshipToImage: floats above the blurred background flag
placed in a clear area of the background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A fluid, informal script for the emotional headline paired with a formal, stable serif for the corporate identity.
graphicDevices: Small red apple icon as a brand mark
Soft drop shadow on the foreground flag to separate it from the background

preserve: The contrast between the script and serif fonts
The dark navy color for text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual, fluid motion of the headline.
Provides the necessary traditional serif look for the branding.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a layered image of the American flag. The background layer should be a soft-focus, desaturated, and brightened flag texture. The foreground layer should be a sharp, high-contrast waving American flag positioned diagonally from the bottom-left toward the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large script headline in dark navy blue at the top. Place a serif brand name and a small red icon in the bottom-right corner, followed by a small URL in a bold sans-serif or serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the background flag significantly lighter and blurrier than the foreground flag?
Is the headline text dark navy blue?
Is the branding positioned in the bottom-right corner?
Is the script font fluid and connected?

adjustableVariables: Blur intensity of the background flag

mustAchieve: Clear depth separation between flag layers

postGenerationChecks: Check for two distinct layers of flag imagery.
Ensure the headline is in a script font.
Verify the color palette is strictly patriotic (red, white, blue).
Confirm the branding is in the bottom-right quadrant.
recipe.reuseFormula: Layered flag photography + Script display type + Serif metadata + Diagonal composition = Patriotic Promotional Style.
